scenarios.name: specialist-handoff-with-context
scenarios.description: User describes a technical problem — receptionist hands off to tech specialist with full conversation context, specialist picks up seamlessly

turns.speak: I'm having trouble with the whisper model, it's producing garbled output on short audio clips
I've already tried increasing the window size and that didn't help
the audio is 16 kilohertz mono PCM, about two seconds long, sent as raw WebSocket binary frames
yes I've verified the sample rate matches by checking the WAV header
that fixed it, thanks, what was wrong

scenarios.name: rejection-with-fallback
scenarios.description: Specialist agent rejects the handoff — the request doesn't match their domain — receptionist falls back and offers alternatives

turns.speak: transfer me to billing, I have a question about my invoice
I just want to know why I was charged twice last month
yes please, connect me to accounts instead
I have the invoice number here, it's INV dash two zero two six dash zero four one two

scenarios.name: parallel-agent-consensus
scenarios.description: User asks a question that requires input from three specialists — agents run in parallel, receptionist synthesizes their responses

turns.speak: I need to know: can we deploy the new voice model to production this week
check with the infrastructure team, the QA team, and the security team at the same time
so infrastructure says yes, QA says no because of the accuracy regression, and security has a pending audit — is that right
ask QA if there's a workaround that would let us deploy to staging at least
what's the consolidated recommendation from all three teams

scenarios.name: remote-http-agent
scenarios.description: User asks a question that requires calling an external HTTP A2A agent — request marshalled, response integrated into conversation

turns.speak: ask the weather agent what the forecast is for San Francisco tomorrow
also ask what the air quality index will be
so should I bike to work or drive
actually, ask the weather agent for the hourly breakdown so I can see when the rain starts

scenarios.name: timeout-and-recovery
scenarios.description: Remote agent times out — local agent detects the timeout, informs user clearly, offers alternatives

turns.speak: query the remote analytics agent for the monthly active user count
try once more with a longer timeout
ok it's not responding, can you check if the analytics service is even up
it's definitely down, use the cached report from yesterday instead and tell me that number
also file an incident ticket for the analytics team

scenarios.name: escalation-chain
scenarios.description: User's issue escalates through three tiers: receptionist → specialist → senior engineer → resolution

turns.speak: the voice server is crashing every ten minutes in production, this is urgent
it's a segfault in the ggml library during matrix multiplication
we're already on the latest build, it started after we enabled the parakeet engine
I can try disabling parakeet and falling back to moonshine for now, would that be a temporary fix
ok do it, switch production to moonshine and open a bug for the parakeet crash
confirm the switch was applied and the service is stable

scenarios.name: context-preservation-across-handoffs
scenarios.description: User's context must survive multiple handoffs — each new agent picks up without the user repeating information

turns.speak: hi, I'm Jane from the mobile team, I need help with the voice API, my app ID is mobile dash three seven
the transcribe endpoint returns empty results for audio files under three seconds
what's the current minimum audio length for the voice API
transfer me to someone who can change that threshold
I don't want to repeat myself, do you have my context from the previous agent

scenarios.name: agent-discovery-and-routing
scenarios.description: User asks for help with something the receptionist doesn't handle — agent discovers available specialist agents and routes to the best match

turns.speak: I need to schedule a database migration for next Tuesday at 3 AM
I don't know which team handles that, can you figure it out
yes, transfer me to the database ops team
it's the user profiles database, migrating from Postgres 15 to 17
we need less than 30 minutes of downtime and a rollback plan
